description.en: Hao Zhang's research group at Fudan University: AI for science in materials and semiconductors, quantum materials, and non-Hermitian photonics.

en: Welcome to the homepage of Hao Zhang's group at Fudan University. We bring artificial intelligence, first-principles computation and optics together to understand and design materials and devices.

Our research spans AI for science in materials and in the semiconductor industry, the computation and prediction of novel quantum materials, and non-Hermitian theory with applications in ultrafast optical systems. Results appear in journals such as Nature Communications, Advanced Materials and Light: Science & Applications; see our publications.
zh: 欢迎访问复旦大学张浩课题组主页。我们结合人工智能、第一性原理计算与光学，研究和设计新型材料与器件。
我们的研究方向包括：AI4Science 在材料与半导体工业中的应用、新兴量子材料性质的计算与预测，以及非厄米理论与超快非厄米系统。相关成果发表于 Nature Communications、Advanced Materials、Light: Science & Applications 等期刊，详见论文。
课题组隶属于复旦大学未来信息创新学院。
本课题组欢迎人工智能、光学、材料、物理和微电子背景的同学加入，欢迎与我们联系。

en: Hao Zhang is an Associate Professor and doctoral supervisor at Fudan University, and a National Outstanding Mentor for Innovation and Entrepreneurship. Dr. Zhang studied physics at Nanjing University (B.S. and M.S., 1996–2003) and received a Ph.D. from the School of Information Science and Technology, Fudan University (2003–2006). From 2006 to 2025 Dr. Zhang was a faculty member of the Department of Optical Science and Engineering in the School of Information Science and Technology, and has been with the College of Future Information Technology at Fudan since 2025.

Dr. Zhang was a visiting scholar at the University of Konstanz, Germany (Sep 2009 – Aug 2010), the U.S. DOE Ames Laboratory (Oct 2016 – Sep 2017), and the School of Engineering, Rutgers University (Dec 2024 – Jun 2025).

Dr. Zhang has published more than 140 SCI papers, including 5 ESI highly cited papers and papers in high-impact journals such as Nature Communications, Advanced Materials and Light: Science & Applications. More than 40 papers appeared in journals with an impact factor of 10 or above; the work has been cited more than 6,100 times by others, more than 14 papers have each been cited over 100 times, and the h-index exceeds 42. Dr. Zhang serves as a reviewer for Chemical Reviews, Advanced Functional Materials, Physical Review Letters and other journals.

Research interests include AI applications in the semiconductor industry and photonics, high-throughput computation and novel properties of quantum and energy materials, and non-Hermitian systems and their realizations.
zh: 张浩，副教授，博士生导师，国家级优秀创新创业导师。1996–2003 年就读于南京大学物理系，获本科、硕士学位；2003–2006 年于复旦大学信息学院获博士学位。2006–2025 年任职于复旦大学信息学院光科学与工程系，2025 年至今任职于复旦大学未来信息创新学院。
2009 年 9 月至 2010 年 8 月访问德国 Konstanz 大学；2016 年 10 月至 2017 年 9 月访问美国 Ames 能源部实验室；2024 年 12 月至 2025 年 6 月访问美国罗格斯大学工学院。

在国内外刊物上发表 SCI 论文 140 余篇，含 5 篇 ESI 高被引论文与 Nature Communications、Advanced Materials、Light: Science and Applications 等高影响因子杂志论文。发表 10 分及以上的论文 40 余篇，他引总计超过 6100 次，单篇引用超 100 次的论文 14 篇以上，h-index 超过 42。担任 Chem Rev、AFM、PRL 等刊物审稿人。
研究内容包括人工智能的半导体工业与光子学应用、量子材料与能源材料的物性高通量计算与新颖物性研究、非厄米系统及实现等方面研究。
